name: Copy
summary: Edit every word on a screen in one list, and find the placeholder text you forgot to replace
_note: THE REFERENCE APP (studio-apps.md §13). Copy this package, rename the scheme, and you have a Despia app that already obeys every rule the shelf checks: a docked side panel as its placement, StudioKit for every pixel, grants it actually uses and no others, a tool row that runs headless from the CLI and MCP, and no colour literal anywhere. It is also a real app rather than a demo - copy is the thing every team fixes last and ships wrong, and this reads a screen's words through the tree seam and writes them back through the surgery door, so every change is a commit you can revert. The browser oracle (packages/dom/oracle/studio-apps-browser.ts) mounts THIS package rather than a copy of it, so the screenshots in the proof set are pictures of the example an author is handed.

audit.title: Find placeholder copy
audit.description: Scan this project's screens for text nobody replaced - Lorem ipsum, TODO, Untitled, 'Text' - and report where each one is, so a launch never ships with a placeholder on it. Runs from the panel, from `despia app run copy findPlaceholders`, and from an agent over MCP
